edition.name: TagpAI Clinical Dialogue
edition.subtitle: A human annotation tool for AI research
edition.about: Annotate symptoms, change processes and therapist strategies in conversations between a therapist and a patient. A guided practice on a made-up session shows how.

intro: A demonstration with a made-up case. The page makes no network requests of its own and stores nothing in the browser: when you reload or close it, it starts afresh.
